functions.name: batch-get-website-intelligence
functions.description: Look up technologies and optional traffic/spend signals for up to ten websites in one native request, returning per-website complete, pending or failed results.

urls.description: Distinct HTTP(S) website URLs to look up in one native request.

maxAge.description: Oldest verification month in calendar months before the current UTC month.

minAge.description: Newest verification month in calendar months before the current UTC month.

includeSignals.description: Request relative traffic and technology-spend levels when available.

FunctionInput_wappalyzer_batchgetwebsite.description: Website URLs and shared intelligence lookup options.

url.description: Website associated with this result, as returned by the provider; use for correlation rather than array position.

errors.description: Provider per-site failure explanations for failed items; exact provider strings are preserved, with no invented success or error codes.

items.description: An exact provider per-site failure explanation.

status.description: Complete intelligence, pending crawl, or a provider per-site failure.

technologies.description: Detected technologies when supplied; may be partial while pending.

id.description: Opaque category ID represented as text, when supplied.

confirmedAt.description: Confirmation instant in UTC after validated unit conversion, when supplied.

trafficLevel.description: Relative monthly hostname traffic level, when available.

technologySpend.description: Relative estimated technology spend, when requested and available.

items.description: Provider-returned URL-correlated results, not fabricated successes for every input.

FunctionOutput_wappalyzer_batchgetwebsit.description: Complete, pending, or failed website intelligence results.

tags.instructions: Use for 1–10 website URLs. Use `get-website-intelligence` for one URL when you need recursive:false. Batch lookup is recursive and may return pending crawl markers; it does not wait for crawls. Inspect pending URLs later. Do not blindly replay live scans after an unclear outcome.

functions.name: batch-list-subdomains

FunctionInput_wappalyzer_batchlistsubdom.description: One to ten distinct domains and an optional shared native page limit.

hostname.description: Hostname from the upstream subdomains map key.

createdAt.description: Provider record creation instant in UTC.

updatedAt.description: Provider record update instant in UTC.

items.description: A discovered website-serving subdomain and its record timestamps.
Discovered website-serving subdomains returned for this domain in the native page.

Provider-returned domain groups; correlate by domain, not array position.

FunctionOutput_wappalyzer_batchlistsubdo.description: One native discovery page, grouped by the domains returned by the provider.

tags.instructions: Use for 1–10 domains. Each result has its own nextCursor; continue a particular domain with `list-subdomains`, passing that token and the same limit. Use `list-subdomains` directly for one domain or an existing continuation. Limit defaults to 10, with multiples of ten from 10 to 100.

functions.name: create-lead-list
functions.description: Start calculating a lead list using technology, geography, business, verification-age, and exclusion criteria. Return its ID without waiting for calculation or purchasing the result.

sets.description: Export field sets to include; signals adds technologySpend and trafficLevel.

format.description: Desired exported row format; omitted uses the provider default.

maxAge.description: Oldest verification month, counted in calendar months before the current UTC month; default 2 includes two previous months.

minAge.description: Newest verification month, counted in calendar months before the current UTC month; 0 includes the current month.

subset.description: Optional provider subset selector; retain a known Wappalyzer value without interpreting undocumented scale.

rootPath.description: Apply the provider's root-path selection option; omitted uses its default.

baseListId.description: Existing lead list used as the provider's base-list selection source.

subdomains.description: Provider treatment of subdomains: include them, exclude them, or merge them.

subsetSlice.description: Optional provider subset slice, from 0 through 4.

companySizes.description: Provider company-size selectors; values retain provider-defined meaning rather than an assumed employee-count unit.

requiredSets.description: Provider result field sets required for a website to qualify.

technologies.description: Technology criteria identified by provider slugs; obtain slugs from website intelligence or the user's Wappalyzer criteria.

slug.description: Provider technology slug, such as wordpress.

version.description: Optional version criterion; omission leaves the version unspecified.

operator.description: Comparison to the version criterion, when specified.

excludeListId.description: Existing lead list whose websites should be excluded.

excludeNoTraffic.description: Exclude websites classified by the provider as having no traffic.

matchTechnologies.description: Match any technology, all technologies, or exclude matching technologies; omitted uses the provider default.

suppressionListId.description: Ready account suppression list whose immutable domains are excluded before limits and credit calculation.

excludeMultilingual.description: Exclude websites classified by the provider as multilingual.

matchCountryLanguage.description: Apply the provider's country/language matching option; omitted uses its default.

FunctionInput_wappalyzer_createleadlist.description: Criteria for starting a lead-list calculation without purchasing its results.

id.description: New lead-list ID to inspect with get-lead-list.

status.description: The request has started calculation; results are not yet purchased.

FunctionOutput_wappalyzer_createleadlist.description: The newly created lead list and its initial calculation status.

tags.instructions: Use to generate a new lead list. Get existing list IDs from `list-lead-lists` and use only a Ready suppression ID from `get-suppression-list`. After creation, check `get-lead-list`; when Ready, use `finalize-lead-list` to spend credits. Calculation is asynchronous and this tool does not wait for it.

functions.name: create-suppression-list
functions.description: Create an immutable domain suppression list from domains or website URLs. Return the reusable ID after upload without waiting for asynchronous validation.

name.description: Optional account label; omission lets the provider use the returned ID.

items.description: A domain or HTTP(S) URL without embedded line breaks.

entries.description: Domains or HTTP(S) URLs to exclude, one entry per array item; no embedded line breaks. At most 250,000 submitted entries and 20 MiB after UTF-8 serialization.

FunctionInput_wappalyzer_createsuppressi.description: Domains or website URLs to upload as one immutable suppression list, with an optional account label.

id.description: Reusable suppression-list identifier; usable in lead-list creation only when Ready.

name.description: Label returned by the provider, defaulting to its ID if omitted on creation.

error.description: Provider validation explanation, including rejected content or storage quota, when supplied.

status.description: Current validation or lifecycle state; upload success does not imply Ready.

createdAt.description: Creation instant normalized to UTC with integral-second precision.

retiredAt.description: Retirement instant in UTC, when supplied.

sizeBytes.description: Validated snapshot size in bytes, when supplied.

FunctionOutput_wappalyzer_createsuppress.description: Initial suppression-list metadata after upload; validation may still be pending.

tags.instructions: Use to exclude known websites from future lead lists. Supply ordinary domains or HTTP(S) URLs, not encoded file content. This uses no credits, but every upload creates a new ID and counts toward shared account limits. Check `get-suppression-list` until Ready before using the ID in `create-lead-list`. After an unclear outcome, use `list-suppression-lists` before uploading again.

functions.name: delete-lead-list
functions.description: Delete an account lead list. No restore operation is available in this integration.

leadListId.description: Opaque account lead-list ID to delete.

FunctionInput_wappalyzer_deleteleadlist.description: Select the account lead list to delete.

id.description: Lead-list ID whose deletion request succeeded.

FunctionOutput_wappalyzer_deleteleadlist.description: Correlation identifier for the accepted lead-list deletion.

tags.instructions: Get the ID from `list-lead-lists` and inspect it with `get-lead-list` if needed. This removes the lead list, not the websites it describes. Deleting a list can release a reference to a retired suppression snapshot, but storage cleanup is delayed. Do not assume deletion is recoverable.

functions.name: finalize-lead-list
functions.description: Spend the specified credits to finalize a Ready lead list and obtain its export link when available.

spendCredits.description: Credit amount to submit for finalization, normally the list's reported totalCredits; this is a financial parameter, not a confirmation gate.

FunctionInput_wappalyzer_finalizeleadlis.description: The Ready lead list and the exact credit amount to spend on finalization.

status.description: Provider reports the lead list as Complete.

downloadUrl.description: Export download link when supplied by the provider; omission does not imply finalization failed.

FunctionOutput_wappalyzer_finalizeleadli.description: The completed lead list and its export link when provided, without downloading the export.

tags.instructions: First use `get-lead-list` to check Ready status and totalCredits, and `get-credit-balance` if needed. Finalizing spends credits. Supply the intended credit amount, not a confirmation flag. If the outcome is unclear, inspect the same list before retrying. This tool does not download the export.

functions.name: get-credit-balance

FunctionInput_wappalyzer_getcreditbalanc.description: No input is required to read the connected account credit balance.

tags.instructions: Use before credit-consuming tasks to check the available balance. A balance is a point-in-time value, not a reservation.

functions.name: get-website-intelligence
functions.description: Get detected technologies and optional traffic/spend signals for one website, or return a pending crawl state without waiting for the crawl.

live.description: Allow real-time scanning when needed rather than relying only on cached results.

maxAge.description: Oldest verification calendar month, counted before the current UTC month.

minAge.description: Newest verification calendar month, counted before the current UTC month; zero includes this month.

recursive.description: Follow internal links for coverage; a required recursive crawl returns pending instead of blocking.

includeSignals.description: Request relative technology-spend and monthly traffic levels when available.

FunctionInput_wappalyzer_getwebsiteintel.description: Lookup options for one HTTP(S) website, with optional live scanning and intelligence signals.

url.description: Website URL associated with this result, as returned by the provider.

errors.description: Provider per-website error explanations when status is failed; not invented item status codes.

status.description: Complete intelligence, a pending crawl, or a per-website failure; pending technology data may be partial.

technologies.description: Detected technologies when supplied; an empty array means no reported detections, not failure.

cpe.description: Common Platform Enumeration identifier, when supplied.

slug.description: Technology identifier slug usable in lead-list criteria.

versions.description: Detected versions, when supplied; an empty array is preserved.

id.description: Opaque provider category ID, represented losslessly as text when supplied.

items.description: A category assigned to the detected technology.

confirmedAt.description: Confirmation instant normalized to UTC, when supplied and its upstream units are validated.

trafficRank.description: Provider traffic-rank value on this detection, when supplied; no conversion or invented ranking population.

trafficLevel.description: Relative monthly hostname traffic level, when requested and current data is available.

technologySpend.description: Relative estimated technology spend, when requested and available; not a currency amount.

FunctionOutput_wappalyzer_getwebsiteinte.description: Complete website intelligence, a pending crawl with any partial data, or a per-website failure.

tags.instructions: Use for one known website URL; use `batch-get-website-intelligence` for up to ten URLs. Recursive lookups can start an asynchronous crawl and return pending. Inspect again later with the same URL rather than expecting this call to wait. Live scans may consume credits and must not be blindly replayed after an unclear result. No notification subscription is created.

Retiring does not necessarily reclaim storage immediately.

functions.name: retire-suppression-list
functions.description: Prevent a suppression ID from being used for new lead lists and schedule unreferenced snapshot data for deletion.

suppressionListId.description: Account suppression-list ID to retire from future use.

FunctionInput_wappalyzer_retiresuppressi.description: Select the account suppression list to retire.

id.description: Suppression-list identifier whose retirement was requested.

name.description: Account label for the suppression list.

status.description: Provider-reported lifecycle state after the request; no immediate physical deletion is implied.
